userStories.title: Add TLS error patterns to error classification

userStories.title: Add checkpoint resume to iterative match stage
acceptanceCriteria: Save pass progress to checkpoint after each iterative pass completes
Restore pass state on resume (which pass, which gaps already attempted)
Preserve learned queries across resume to avoid redundant searches
Handle case: iterative match runs out of budget on resume
userStories.notes: Implemented: Added _save_pass_checkpoint() to save intermediate checkpoint after each pass with pass_num, gaps_remaining, attempted_gap_indices, used_queries, fetched_video_ids, and matches. Added _check_for_pass_checkpoint() to detect and restore pass state on resume. Added resume logic that restores _used_queries and _fetched_video_ids to avoid redundant searches. Added budget exhaustion handling with resume_budget_check and max_queries_per_run config options. Added config options to iterative_matching.py. All acceptance criteria verified.
